scope: Visible-appearance descriptions for exactly the 18 pinned CoK Amiga charS/charT atlas-cell IDs (cells 1, 32 and 67 on disks 1-3). The six distinct cell images were reviewed using the source CMAP palette and inverted fifth-plane mask, rendered in memory over a checkerboard. No cell PNG is saved; no subject identity, gameplay usage, selector meaning, or animation semantics are asserted.

assets.visualDescription: A 24×24 pixel cell with a compact multicolored form: pale gray pixels at the upper left, green and deep-blue blocks across the center, a short red band below, cyan pixels along the lower edge, and black and gray angular pixels rising at the right. Transparent pixels surround the form.
